name: Gear Calculator
blurb: pitch and outside diameter and centre distance from module and teeth
intro: The pitch, tip, root and base diameters of an external spur or helical gear pair and the centre distance between them, from module (or diametral pitch), tooth counts, pressure angle and optional profile shift. Standard full-depth involute teeth, ISO 21771 geometry as in the KHK gear reference.

inputs.label: Target centre distance
inputs.help: Optional. When given, the profile shifts follow from it (the x1 + x2 this centre distance needs, split z2 : z1) and x1, x2 above are ignored.

usage: Give the module in mm (or diametral pitch), both tooth counts, the pressure angle, helix angle in degrees (0 = spur) and profile shift coefficients (0 = standard). It returns the centre distance in mm, ratio, pitch/tip/root/base diameters of both gears, tooth thickness, contact ratio and undercut warnings. Or give a target centre distance aw to get the profile shifts it needs. It also returns CAD variables. Use it to lay out a gear pair in CAD or check a centre distance.
sources: ISO 21771:2007 gear geometry and ISO 53 basic rack
KHK Gear Technical Reference, section 4: calculation of gear dimensions (profile-shifted spur and helical gears), incl. the worked example m3, z 12/24, x 0.6/0.36, aw = 56.4999 mm
